Sample.evidence_source: [/page/1/Text/10] Participants were eligible if they (1) had previous experiences of suicidality, (2) were at least 19 years old, (3) self-identifed as a gay, bisexual or two-spirit man, and (4) spoke English.

Country.evidence_source: [/page/1/Text/10] participants were recruited through the distribution of posters within Vancouver's gay village and online via social media sites.

Population.evidence_source: [/page/1/Text/10] Participants were eligible if they (1) had previous experiences of suicidality, (2) were at least 19 years old, (3) self-identifed as a gay, bisexual or two-spirit man, and (4) spoke English.

Type.evidence_source: [/page/1/Text/11] Data collection occurred in two stages. At a frst meeting, participants read and signed the consent form, received a camera (if the participant already had a camera, he received a $100 honorarium, the equivalent cost of the camera) and completed a demographic questionnaire. The purpose of the study and potential risks for participating were discussed. Participants were asked to take photographs to illustrate their previous experiences of suicidality, including what they believed caused and/or triggered their suicide thoughts, the strategies they used to manage their suicidality, and their perspectives on GB2SM's suicide. For each photograph, participants were invited to write a caption.
